svg.title: When a backend leaves: modulo hashing versus consistent hashing
svg.desc: Visual comparison showing how modulo hashing remaps most keys when a backend leaves versus consistent hashing and Maglev hashing moving only about one in N keys, and why hash affinity matters in cache locality, L4 load balancing, and LLM prefix caching.

svg.text: Why it matters in three places

g.text: lab check: rendezvous (HRW) hashing moves about 1/N of keys; bounded-load spillover
Hash affinity accepts uneven load, so plan for reshuffling
